title: Before pixels: Modular industrial dashboards
summary: This article explores the history of modular industrial control panels and dashboards that existed before digital pixel-based displays became prevalent. It examines the design principles, functionality, and evolution of analog industrial control systems used in factories and industrial settings throughout the 20th century.
problem_solved: Documents the design principles and historical evolution of industrial dashboards before digital displays, preserving knowledge of early human-machine interface design.
why_valuable: Provides valuable historical context for understanding the origins of modern dashboard and interface design, showing that modular, functional design principles predate digital technology.
